easy: Left standing in one place, like a car that is not moving.

ex.en: Four parked cars were lined up in front of our school.
ex.ko: 우리 학교 앞에 주차된 차 네 대가 줄지어 있었다.

easy: A soft, thick mix that you can spread or squeeze.

ex.en: Mom mixed flour and water into a thick paste.
ex.ko: 엄마는 밀가루와 물을 섞어 걸쭉한 반죽을 만들었다.

easy: An open place in a town where people can walk and meet.

ex.en: We ate ice cream in the plaza after school.
ex.ko: 우리는 방과 후 광장에서 아이스크림을 먹었다.

easy: Doing very well and having lots of money and good luck.

ex.en: The little town enjoyed years of prosperity.
ex.ko: 그 작은 마을은 여러 해 동안 번영을 누렸다.

easy: Used for fun and play in your free time.

ex.en: Our town has a recreational center with a pool.
ex.ko: 우리 동네에는 수영장이 있는 레크리에이션 센터가 있다.

easy: Able to be used again for more time, like a library book.

ex.en: My library book is renewable for two more weeks.
ex.ko: 내 도서관 책은 2주 더 대출 갱신을 할 수 있다.

easy: Able to be replaced by nature so it never runs out.

ex.en: Wind and sunlight give us renewable energy.
ex.ko: 바람과 햇빛은 우리에게 재생 가능한 에너지를 준다.

easy: A bag from a store that holds the things you buy.

ex.en: Dad carried the groceries home in a big paper sack.
ex.ko: 아빠는 식료품을 큰 종이 봉지에 담아 집으로 가져왔다.

easy: To look at someone or something for a long time without looking away.

ex.en: The puppy stared at my sandwich.
ex.ko: 강아지가 내 샌드위치를 빤히 쳐다봤다.

easy: To keep your eyes on one thing without moving them.

ex.en: The girl stared out the window at the rain.
ex.ko: 소녀는 창밖의 비를 응시했다.

easy: Very, very much. It makes the next word stronger.

ex.en: The movie was terribly funny.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 무척 웃겼다.

easy: In a very bad way.

ex.en: My little brother sings terribly, but he loves it.
ex.ko: 내 동생은 노래를 형편없이 하지만 아주 좋아한다.

easy: Guarding your own place and not letting others come in.

ex.en: Our dog is territorial and barks at strangers in the yard.
ex.ko: 우리 개는 텃세가 심해서 마당에 온 낯선 사람에게 짖는다.

easy: A scary, exciting story or movie where you wonder what will happen next.

ex.en: I read a thriller about a missing dog.
ex.ko: 나는 사라진 개에 관한 스릴러를 읽었다.

easy: Having problems or danger; not safe or calm.

ex.en: The troubled town needed help after the flood.
ex.ko: 홍수 뒤 어려움에 처한 마을은 도움이 필요했다.

easy: An animal with a hard shell on its back that walks slowly or swims.

ex.en: The turtle pulled its head into its shell.
ex.ko: 거북이는 머리를 등딱지 안으로 쏙 집어넣었다.

easy: Using words, spoken or written.

ex.en: Reading every day helps build your verbal skills.
ex.ko: 매일 책을 읽으면 언어 능력이 자란다.

easy: Warm cloth made from the hair of sheep.

ex.en: My warm wool socks keep my feet cozy.
ex.ko: 내 따뜻한 양모 양말은 발을 포근하게 해 준다.

easy: The thick, soft hair cut from sheep that is made into yarn.

ex.en: The farmer cut the wool from the sheep.
ex.ko: 농부는 양에게서 털을 깎았다.

easy: Having to explain or answer for what you do.

ex.en: Everyone is accountable for their own homework.
ex.ko: 누구나 자기 숙제에 책임이 있다.

easy: What is left or what happens after something very bad.

ex.en: In the aftermath of the storm, trees were down all over town.
ex.ko: 폭풍의 여파로 온 동네에 나무가 쓰러져 있었다.

easy: What happens because of something that happened before.

ex.en: The big mess was the aftermath of our party.
ex.ko: 그 큰 엉망은 우리 파티의 결과였다.

easy: A habit of being angry and ready to fight or hurt others.

ex.en: The teacher talked to him about his aggression on the playground.
ex.ko: 선생님은 운동장에서 보이는 그의 공격성에 대해 이야기했다.

easy: An angry feeling that makes you want to attack.

ex.en: The dog showed aggression when strangers came close.
ex.ko: 개는 낯선 사람이 가까이 오자 공격성을 보였다.

easy: Looked at very carefully, piece by piece.

ex.en: The analyzed results showed that our plant grew the tallest.
ex.ko: 분석된 결과는 우리 식물이 가장 많이 자랐다고 보여 주었다.

easy: A very big, strong bag filled with hot air or gas that lifts people into the sky.

ex.en: We watched a hot air balloon float over the field.
ex.ko: 우리는 열기구가 들판 위로 떠가는 것을 보았다.

easy: A thin rubber bag you blow up with air for parties.

ex.en: My balloon popped with a loud bang!
ex.ko: 내 풍선이 펑 하고 크게 터졌다!

easy: To make a feeling or pain weaker.

ex.en: Good music can blunt your sad feelings.
ex.ko: 좋은 음악은 슬픈 기분을 누그러뜨릴 수 있다.

easy: The parts of a car or bike that make it slow down or stop.

ex.en: Dad pressed the brakes when the light turned red.
ex.ko: 신호가 빨간색으로 바뀌자 아빠는 브레이크를 밟았다.

easy: Hiding something by covering it with dirt.

ex.en: The dog loved the burial of his bone in the yard.
ex.ko: 개는 마당에 뼈다귀를 묻는 것을 아주 좋아했다.

easy: A counting number like one, two, or three that tells how many.

ex.en: In math class we learned that 1, 2, and 3 are cardinal numbers.
ex.ko: 수학 시간에 1, 2, 3이 기수라는 것을 배웠다.

easy: To chew loudly with big bites.

ex.en: The horse champed on its hay.
ex.ko: 말이 건초를 우적우적 씹었다.

easy: Many people saying the same thing at the same time.

ex.en: The class answered in a chorus of "Yes!"
ex.ko: 반 아이들이 한목소리로 "네!"라고 대답했다.

easy: A group of people who sing together.

ex.en: Our school chorus sings at the spring concert.
ex.ko: 우리 학교 합창단은 봄 음악회에서 노래한다.

easy: Being easy to understand.

ex.en: The teacher explained the rule with clarity.
ex.ko: 선생님은 규칙을 명확하게 설명했다.

easy: How clear and see-through something is, like clean water.

ex.en: We could see the fish because of the clarity of the lake water.
ex.ko: 호숫물이 맑아서 물고기가 보였다.

easy: Something you use to wash and clean things.

ex.en: Mom used a cleaner to wipe the kitchen table.
ex.ko: 엄마는 세제로 주방 식탁을 닦았다.

easy: A person who runs a shop that cleans clothes.

ex.en: The cleaner got the stain out of my dad's jacket.
ex.ko: 세탁소 주인 아저씨가 아빠 재킷의 얼룩을 지워 주었다.

easy: Two or more things coming together to become one.

ex.en: The combining of blue and yellow makes green.
ex.ko: 파란색과 노란색이 합쳐지면 초록색이 된다.

easy: Putting things together to make something new.

ex.en: Combining flour and eggs is the first step.
ex.ko: 밀가루와 달걀을 섞는 것이 첫 단계이다.

easy: Meant to be kept secret and not told to others.

ex.en: My best friend told me something confidential.
ex.ko: 가장 친한 친구가 나에게 비밀 이야기를 해 주었다.

easy: The way your body parts move well together.

ex.en: Playing soccer helps my coordination.
ex.ko: 축구를 하면 내 협응력이 좋아진다.

easy: Getting different people or parts to work well together.

ex.en: The teacher's coordination helped field day go smoothly.
ex.ko: 선생님의 조율 덕분에 운동회가 순조롭게 진행되었다.

easy: The freedom to decide something by yourself.

ex.en: The coach has discretion to choose who plays first.
ex.ko: 감독님은 누가 먼저 뛸지 정할 재량이 있다.

easy: Being careful about what you say or do so you do not hurt anyone's feelings.

ex.en: She used discretion and kept the surprise party a secret.
ex.ko: 그녀는 신중하게 깜짝 파티를 비밀로 지켰다.

easy: A round roof shaped like half a ball.

ex.en: The museum has a huge glass dome.
ex.ko: 그 박물관에는 거대한 유리 돔이 있다.

easy: A warm feeling of liking and respect for someone.

ex.en: The students hold their teacher in high esteem.
ex.ko: 학생들은 선생님을 매우 존경한다.

easy: Put inside a frame, like a picture on a wall.

ex.en: A framed photo of our dog hangs in the hall.
ex.ko: 우리 개 사진이 담긴 액자가 복도에 걸려 있다.

easy: A movement of your hands or body that shows what you think or feel.

ex.en: He made a funny gesture to make us laugh.
ex.ko: 그는 우리를 웃기려고 우스꽝스러운 몸짓을 했다.

easy: A hand sign that tells others something without words.

ex.en: A thumbs-up is a gesture that means good job.
ex.ko: 엄지척은 잘했다는 뜻의 손짓이다.

easy: A pretend animal in stories with an eagle's head and wings and a lion's body.

ex.en: In the story, a griffin guarded the gold.
ex.ko: 이야기 속에서 그리핀이 황금을 지켰다.

easy: Flat and level, going from side to side like the ground.

ex.en: Draw a horizontal line across your paper.
ex.ko: 종이를 가로질러 수평선을 그려 보세요.

easy: A line or thing that lies flat from side to side.

ex.en: The middle bar of the letter H is a horizontal.
ex.ko: 알파벳 H의 가운데 막대는 가로선이다.

easy: Being kind and friendly to guests.

ex.en: Grandma showed great hospitality and cooked for every guest.
ex.ko: 할머니는 모든 손님을 따뜻하게 대접하며 음식을 해 주셨다.

easy: In a way that cannot be stopped; it has to happen.

ex.en: If you never study, you will inevitably get a bad grade.
ex.ko: 공부를 전혀 안 하면 어쩔 수 없이 나쁜 점수를 받게 된다.

easy: A boy.

ex.en: The lad ran across the field to catch the ball.
ex.ko: 소년은 공을 잡으려고 들판을 가로질러 달렸다.

easy: Being able to read and write.

ex.en: Reading books every day builds literacy.
ex.ko: 매일 책을 읽으면 문해력이 자란다.

easy: Making you believe something that is not true.

ex.en: The sign was misleading, so we took the wrong road.
ex.ko: 표지판이 오해를 일으켜서 우리는 엉뚱한 길로 갔다.

easy: A little bit of water on or in something.

ex.en: Moisture on the cold window made it foggy.
ex.ko: 차가운 창문에 맺힌 습기 때문에 뿌옇게 되었다.

easy: Thinking about one thing so much that you cannot stop.

ex.en: He has an obsession with video games and thinks about them all day.
ex.ko: 그는 비디오 게임에 집착해서 하루 종일 그 생각만 한다.

easy: The nut that grows underground inside a shell.

ex.en: I cracked the shell and found two peanuts inside.
ex.ko: 껍질을 깠더니 안에 땅콩이 두 알 있었다.

easy: A plant whose seeds grow in pods under the ground.

ex.en: A peanut plant grows its pods in the soil.
ex.ko: 땅콩 식물은 꼬투리를 흙 속에서 키운다.

easy: Never stopping; going on and on.

ex.en: The persistent rain kept us inside all day.
ex.ko: 끊임없이 내리는 비 때문에 우리는 하루 종일 안에 있었다.

easy: Keeps coming back into your mind again and again.

ex.en: A persistent tune kept playing in my head.
ex.ko: 그 노래 가락이 계속 머릿속에서 맴돌았다.

easy: Having to do with medicine.

ex.en: My aunt works at a pharmaceutical company.
ex.ko: 이모는 제약 회사에서 일한다.

easy: A line of things that follow a pattern, one after another.

ex.en: The numbers 2, 4, 6, 8 are a progression.
ex.ko: 2, 4, 6, 8은 규칙적으로 이어지는 수열이다.

easy: To build something again.

ex.en: After the storm, we rebuilt our tree house.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 지나간 뒤 우리는 나무 위 집을 다시 지었다.

easy: Saying no and not accepting something.

ex.en: Her idea met with rejection, so she tried a new one.
ex.ko: 그녀의 생각은 거절당해서 새로운 생각을 시도했다.

easy: The sad feeling of being told no or not being wanted.

ex.en: He felt rejection when nobody picked him for the team.
ex.ko: 아무도 그를 팀에 뽑지 않자 그는 거절당한 기분이 들었다.

easy: Helping you rest and feel calm.

ex.en: A warm bath is very relaxing.
ex.ko: 따뜻한 목욕은 아주 편안하다.

easy: A feeling you get from your body, like touch or heat.

ex.en: I felt a tingling sensation when my foot fell asleep.
ex.ko: 발이 저릴 때 찌릿찌릿한 느낌이 들었다.

easy: A person who takes care of sheep.

ex.en: The shepherd led his sheep up the hill.
ex.ko: 양치기는 양들을 이끌고 언덕을 올랐다.

easy: The small light thing with feathers that you hit in badminton.

ex.en: I hit the shuttle over the net.
ex.ko: 나는 셔틀콕을 네트 너머로 쳤다.

easy: A bus, train, or plane that goes back and forth between two places.

ex.en: We took the shuttle from the airport to the hotel.
ex.ko: 우리는 공항에서 호텔까지 셔틀을 탔다.

easy: A small bit of food you eat between meals.

ex.en: I eat an apple as my after-school snack.
ex.ko: 나는 방과 후 간식으로 사과를 먹는다.

easy: To eat a small amount of food between meals.

ex.en: I like to snack on crackers while I read.
ex.ko: 나는 책을 읽으며 크래커를 간식으로 먹는 것을 좋아한다.

easy: When many people are looking at you and paying attention to you.

ex.en: The winner stepped into the spotlight.
ex.ko: 우승자는 모두의 주목을 받으며 앞으로 나왔다.

easy: A very bright lamp that lights one small spot, like on a stage.

ex.en: The spotlight followed the singer across the stage.
ex.ko: 스포트라이트가 무대를 가로지르는 가수를 따라갔다.

easy: Looking serious and strict, not smiling.

ex.en: The teacher had a stern face when we were noisy.
ex.ko: 우리가 시끄럽게 떠들자 선생님은 엄한 얼굴을 했다.

easy: Hard to move or bend.

ex.en: The door was stiff, so I pushed it hard.
ex.ko: 문이 뻑뻑해서 나는 세게 밀었다.

easy: Strong and powerful.

ex.en: A stiff wind lifted my kite high.
ex.ko: 센 바람이 내 연을 높이 띄웠다.

easy: The soccer player who stays near the other team's goal to score.

ex.en: The striker kicked the ball into the goal.
ex.ko: 공격수가 공을 골대 안으로 찼다.

easy: Very big or very strong.

ex.en: A terrific thunderclap shook the house.
ex.ko: 엄청난 천둥소리가 집을 흔들었다.

easy: Being clear so you can see through it.

ex.en: The transparency of the glass let us see the fish.
ex.ko: 유리가 투명해서 물고기가 보였다.

easy: Not having a job.

ex.en: My uncle was unemployed for a few months.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 몇 달 동안 실직 상태였다.

easy: People who do not have jobs.

ex.en: The town built a center to help the unemployed find work.
ex.ko: 시는 실업자들이 일자리를 찾도록 돕는 센터를 지었다.

easy: To join together for the same goal.

ex.en: The whole class united to clean the playground.
ex.ko: 반 전체가 힘을 합쳐 운동장을 청소했다.

easy: To join and become one thing.

ex.en: Two small teams united into one big team.
ex.ko: 작은 두 팀이 합쳐져 큰 한 팀이 되었다.

easy: To open a lock with a key.

ex.en: Dad used his key to unlock the front door.
ex.ko: 아빠는 열쇠로 현관문을 열었다.

easy: A very strong room where money and valuable things are kept safe.

ex.en: The bank keeps gold inside a steel vault.
ex.ko: 은행은 금을 철제 금고실에 보관한다.

easy: To check something very carefully.

ex.en: The teacher will vet our stories before the class book is printed.
ex.ko: 선생님은 학급 문집을 인쇄하기 전에 우리 이야기를 꼼꼼히 검토할 것이다.

easy: A cart with four wheels that is pulled or pushed to carry things.

ex.en: I pulled my little sister in a red wagon.
ex.ko: 나는 빨간 수레에 여동생을 태우고 끌었다.

easy: Staying away from other people and wanting to be alone.

ex.en: After moving, the boy felt withdrawn and sat alone at lunch.
ex.ko: 이사 후 소년은 위축되어 점심시간에 혼자 앉았다.

easy: Bad for you or working against you.

ex.en: The adverse weather made us cancel the picnic.
ex.ko: 나쁜 날씨 때문에 우리는 소풍을 취소했다.

easy: For a short time.

ex.en: Let's rest awhile before we go on.
ex.ko: 계속 가기 전에 잠시 쉬자.

easy: A person whose job is to buy or sell things for others and get paid for it.

ex.en: Our family used a broker to buy our house.
ex.ko: 우리 가족은 중개인을 통해 집을 샀다.

easy: A computer program you use to look at websites.

ex.en: I opened my browser to look up facts about frogs.
ex.ko: 나는 개구리에 관한 정보를 찾으려고 브라우저를 열었다.

easy: To cover something so no one can see it.

ex.en: I buried my feet in the warm sand.
ex.ko: 나는 따뜻한 모래 속에 발을 묻었다.

easy: Having to do with cells, the tiny parts of living things.

ex.en: Plants have cellular walls that keep them strong.
ex.ko: 식물의 세포벽은 식물을 튼튼하게 지켜 준다.

easy: The soft white meat of a big sea fish, eaten as food.

ex.en: We ate fried cod for dinner.
ex.ko: 우리는 저녁으로 대구 튀김을 먹었다.

easy: Made smaller or pulled tight.

ex.en: In bright light, the contracted pupils of your eyes get small.
ex.ko: 밝은 곳에서는 눈동자가 수축해서 작아진다.

easy: Planning how something will look and work, often by drawing it.

ex.en: Designing a robot took me a whole weekend.
ex.ko: 로봇을 설계하는 데 주말 내내 걸렸다.

easy: Causing a lot of damage.

ex.en: The destructive storm broke many trees.
ex.ko: 파괴적인 폭풍이 많은 나무를 부러뜨렸다.

easy: A feeling that you do not like something.

ex.en: My dislike of broccoli is no secret.
ex.ko: 내가 브로콜리를 싫어한다는 건 다들 안다.

easy: A game of badminton with two players on each side.

ex.en: My mom and I won the badminton doubles.
ex.ko: 엄마와 나는 배드민턴 복식에서 이겼다.

easy: A tennis game with two players on each side of the net.

ex.en: My sister and I play tennis doubles every Saturday.
ex.ko: 누나와 나는 토요일마다 테니스 복식을 한다.

easy: Stuck firmly inside something around it.

ex.en: We found small stones embedded in the mud.
ex.ko: 우리는 진흙에 박힌 작은 돌들을 발견했다.

easy: Kind words you say when you are leaving.

ex.en: We waved a sad farewell to Grandma at the airport.
ex.ko: 우리는 공항에서 할머니께 아쉬운 작별 인사를 했다.

easy: The act of saying goodbye and leaving.

ex.en: The long farewell made us all cry.
ex.ko: 긴 작별에 우리 모두 눈물이 났다.

easy: Your hand closed tightly with the fingers curled in.

ex.en: He held a coin in his fist.
ex.ko: 그는 주먹 안에 동전을 쥐고 있었다.

easy: Showing that you care about someone and feel warm toward them.

ex.en: My fond grandma always gives me warm hugs.
ex.ko: 다정한 우리 할머니는 늘 따뜻하게 안아 주신다.

easy: A small animal with long back legs that jumps and lives near water.

ex.en: The frog jumped into the pond with a splash.
ex.ko: 개구리가 첨벙 소리를 내며 연못으로 뛰어들었다.

easy: To cook food in hot oil.

ex.en: Mom will fry eggs for breakfast.
ex.ko: 엄마가 아침으로 달걀 프라이를 해 주실 것이다.

easy: A person who gets money or things from a family member when that person dies.

ex.en: She is the heir to her grandfather's farm.
ex.ko: 그녀는 할아버지 농장의 상속인이다.

easy: A hit in baseball that lets the batter run all the way around and score.

ex.en: He hit a homer over the fence!
ex.ko: 그가 담장 너머로 홈런을 쳤다!

easy: A person from the country of Indonesia.

ex.en: My new classmate is an Indonesian who speaks three languages.
ex.ko: 내 새 짝꿍은 세 가지 언어를 하는 인도네시아 사람이다.

easy: The main language spoken in Indonesia.

ex.en: She is learning Indonesian before her trip.
ex.ko: 그녀는 여행 전에 인도네시아어를 배우고 있다.

easy: A girl donkey. A donkey looks like a small horse with long ears.

ex.en: The jenny followed her baby donkey around the farm.
ex.ko: 암나귀가 농장에서 새끼 나귀를 따라다녔다.

easy: A person who owns a building and lets others pay to live in it.

ex.en: Our landlord fixed the broken sink.
ex.ko: 집주인 아저씨가 고장 난 싱크대를 고쳐 주었다.

easy: A natural liking or habit of wanting to do something.

ex.en: He has a leaning toward science and loves experiments.
ex.ko: 그는 과학에 끌리는 성향이 있어서 실험을 아주 좋아한다.
